hypothesis: Splitting the abstraction cell with the largest measured exact error (best-response gain) lowers raw-game exploitability more than spending the same number of cells uniformly or at random.

domain.game: 52-card river subgame, pot 10, stack 20, bets 50%/100%/all-in, raise cap 2, OOP acts first; ranges sampled from strength-percentile bands
domain.abstraction: per-player partition of the range into strength-ordered cells; infoset = (betting node, cell); perfect recall (single street)
domain.error_metric: exact exploitability of the lifted strategy in the raw game (chips)

limitations: single-street exact domain: findings need not transfer to multi-street imperfect-recall abstractions
cells are contiguous in strength order; splits are at the cell's strength median only
greedy one-split-per-round refinement; no lookahead except the oracle arm
exploitability in chips of a pot-10 subgame; not comparable with full-game bb/100 numbers
